 Grooming Here's Everything You'll Need In Your Diwali 2026 Skincare Hamper 
 From cleansers & serums to moisturisers and sunscreens, here's the complete lowdown on everything you'll need to get for your Diwali skincare hamper Your ultimate guide to building the perfect Diwali skincare hamper Getty Images Saurav Bhanot Updated on :  03 Nov 2026, 10:26 am 
 Copied 
 No festive season is complete without a good skincare hamper because whether you're attending yet another Diwali party this season, or recovering after way too many nights out, you'll need a good set of products to ensure you're glowing all the time, no matter what. So if you're building your skincare hamper whether it is for your own self or to gift someone else, ensure you've got all the right ingredients to help your skin. And for those of you confused about what products should you pack in that hamper, you've come to the right place. Let us tell you everything you need! 
 Things To Include In Your Diwali 2026 Skincare Hamper  
 Step 1: Face Wash  
 It goes without saying, no skincare routine can begin without using a face wash/cleanser.  
 Before you go about applying any product, you need to ensure your skin has been thoroughly cleansed – a good face wash is one that removes all dirt, muck & impurities while also cleaning away remnants of products applied the day or night before. 
 Face Cleansers we recommend: 
 Ssunsu Cera Ginseng Cloud Cleanser 
 SK-II Facial Treatment Gentle Cleanser 
 The Formularx Barrier Comfort Gentle Ceramide Cleanser 
 Code Skin Clarifi Face Wash 
 Step 2: Serum  
 Now that you've cleansed your face, it's time to treat it. Depending on your skin issues, there are different serums to address different kinds of skin concerns. A serum with vitamin C can help address pigmentation, one with niacinamide will help deal with excess oil production and a retinol serum is your best bet against fine lines and wrinkles. If your skin barrier is damaged, you'll need a serum with ceramides and peptides. 
 Serums we recommend:  
 Asaya Glow Forward Radiance Serum 
 Amahvas Ocean of Milk Nocturnal Renewal Concentrate 
 Foxtale Collagen-PDRN Cell Renewal Serum
 Foxtale Cell Renewal Collagen-PDRN Serum Clarins Double Serum Light Texture 
 Clarins Double Serum Light Texture Inde Wild Sunrise Glow 15% Vitamin C Complex Serum 
 Inde Wild Sunrise Glow 15% Vitamin C Complex Serum Step 3: Moisturiser  
 It isn't enough to treat your skin with a good serum – you've also got to lock it all in with a moisturiser. Plus, a good moisturiser will also provide a much-needed dose of hydration to your skin, because lack of adequate moisture is where most of your skincare issues begin, and we don't want that, right? 
 Moisturisers we recommend:  
 Augustinus Bader The Rich Cream 
 Augustinus Bader, 'The Rich Cream' Sephora India Embryolisse Lait-Creme Concentre - Moisturiser and Primer 
 Kama Ayurveda Kumkumadi Youth-Revitalising Soft Cream 
 Forest Essentials Light Hydrating Facial Gel Panchpushp 
 Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler +3X Effect Night Cream 
 You may also like Esquire India Weekly: Start Your Skincare Game Early to Age Like a Pro Step 4: Sunscreen  
 Lastly, the most important step – sunscreen. No amounts of serums & moisturisers can save your skin if you aren't protecting it from the harmful UV rays. SPF 50 is not a choice – it's a must-use for all of us, no matter what the climate outside. Get yourself a good SPF, one that absorbs quickly, doesn't feel too sticky & doesn't leave a white cast. 
 Sunscreens we recommend:   
 ISDIN Fotoprotector Fusion Water Magic Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++ 
 ISDIN Fotoprotector Fusion Water Bioderma Photoderm XDefense Ultra Fluid SPF50+ Invisible Sunscreen 
 Hyphen All I Need Sunscreen Spf 50 PA++++ 
 Compound Pigment Defender Sunscreen 
 La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVMune 400 Anti-Dark Spots Fluid Sunscreen 50+ PA++++
